mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS treatmentCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) AS treatmentAmount, NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount FROM TR_SPEC_TREAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS treatmentCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) AS treatmentAmount, NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount FROM TR_SPEC_TREAT_DTL t INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON t.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE t.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND d.outp_or_inp IN (0, 2)
AND d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY treatmentCount DESC
